chunks: So peace on him the day he was born, the day he will die, and the day that he will be raised from the dead.

key_terms.يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّا: the day he will be raised from the dead

ai.seo_question: What are the three days on which peace is bestowed upon Jesus in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to affirm the peace and honor of Prophet Isa (AS) throughout his earthly journey, with some scholars interpreting 'yawnam yumutu' as his actual death followed by resurrection, while others view it as a metaphorical death or sleep. The triple mention underscores the divine protection granted to him from the moment of his miraculous birth until his ultimate return, reinforcing his status as a chosen messenger.
